title: Juan Van Halen to the acting commander of the Division auxiliar del Norte, Igualada, 6 May 1840 (catalogue 2423, AHN DIVERSOS-COLECCIONES,195,N.14): numbered homophonic alphabets, key proposed from the ciphertext; the pre-registered held-out test failed (key partial); read in part, 27 of 30 cipher words

steps.what: Transcription pass 1 of the eight runs (144 numbers; the contributor counted 146, reading the two '58' as '5.8'), frozen; held-out part S7-S8 (25 numbers) named in the protocol hashed before it.

Index of coincidence 0.059 (below the 1st percentile of Spanish samples of that length); monoalphabetic and homophonic annealing, Gronsfeld-type tests over 24-29-letter alphabets (periods 1-12), letterhead key phrases and context cribs on S1-S6 (issues #363, #367).
Brice Dudout re-read 12 doubtful signs blind on a shape-matching sheet (forms cut from the same letter): pass 2, no value of S1-S6 changed.

Claude Fable 5.2 (one API run, S1-S6 only) proposed alphabets numbered on with homophones, anchored on the isomorph 'en contacto' in S6 (1 window, 0 of 5,000 shuffles); the attested values fall in alphabetical order 16/16 (permuted keys: at most 6). Key frozen.

One pre-registered measurement on held-out S7-S8 (25 numbers, never sent to the model). Declared: original rule P01 (cover >= 0.85 and >= best control + 0.30), replaced by an addendum with thresholds calibrated on S1-S6 (C1 cover >= 0.75; C2 letter model >= best of 200 shuffled keys + 0.22; C3 >= best of 200 shuffles of the held-out numbers + 0.08; all three needed). Score: cover 0.880 (C1 passed; P01 margin 0.120, not met); letter model -1.048 vs -1.359 (C2 passed) and vs -1.101 (C3 failed, short by 0.027). Test failed; by the frozen addendum the key is partial. Raw decode 'lacaretera / dicbosacaretera'. The order of events (addendum hashed before S7-S8 were decoded) is the contributor's record: file timestamps, one commit.

Whole letter read by sense: 30 cipher words, 27 with no correction, 2 probable (one number read otherwise each), 1 restored (one number supplied), 0 unresolved. By the README read bar 27/30 = 90.0% (contributor's count with the probable words: 96.7%).

Integration of pull request #408 after an independent read-only verification: SHA-256 of all frozen files match; a second decoder from key.tsv reproduces decryption.txt (0 differences); P01 re-run identical (0.880, 0.760, margin 0.120); C1 0.880, C2 -1.051 vs -1.357, C3 -1.051 vs -1.102 (missed by 0.029; other Quijote text); calibration re-run 0.75/0.21/0.08, power 82.7%. Larger controls: 0 of 6,000 shuffled keys and 5 of 6,000 group shuffles score as well as the key. With transcription pass 2 (S8 no. 4 = 18) C3 would pass by 0.004; C3 passes in 3 to 6 of 30 seed blocks. Corrections applied: test recorded as failed, key partial, class read in part (27/30 = 0.90), 144 numbers not 146, the 40 structural key values labelled conjecture. Transcription not checked on the images (PARES HTTP 429).

outcome.method_basis: Key proposed by a language model from runs S1-S6 alone (the plain text around the runs gives context, not a parallel text) and frozen. The one pre-registered measurement on runs S7-S8, held out and never sent to the model, failed (C3 short by 0.027; original rule not met), so the key is partial under the contributor's frozen protocol; the 24 attested values read all eight runs, the 40 structural values are conjecture.
outcome.fraction_read_source: reading.md, cipher words: 27 of 30 read with no correction = 90.0% (README read bar: the 2 probable words, one number read otherwise each, count as guessed and the 1 restored word, ve[n]ir, as supplied). Contributor's count with the probable words: 29/30 = 96.7%. Recounted at integration, 12 Nov 2026.

validation.notes: Contributor's pre-registered held-out test (not docs/_validate.py): FAILED. Declared: P01 (cover >= 0.85 and >= best control + 0.30), then an addendum (SHA-256 41a8ea9a309bc9f8a47396d551bde5a53fbfd504546d4467d4a628fd97f4cde3) with C1 cover >= 0.75, C2 lm >= best of 200 shuffled keys + 0.22, C3 lm >= best of 200 group shuffles + 0.08, all three needed. Single measurement on 25 numbers: C1 0.880 passed; C2 -1.048 >= -1.139 passed; C3 -1.048 < -1.021 failed, short by 0.027; P01 not met (0.880, margin 0.120). The frozen addendum (section 5) and result file call this 'mesure non validée, clé partielle'. The PR's 'validated with limited reservations' was a relabelling after the result and is withdrawn. By the contributor's record (file timestamps, one commit, no outside timestamp) the addendum was hashed before S7-S8 were decoded. Other evidence, apart from the test: the 24 attested values run in alphabetical order; S1-S6 give continuous Spanish fitting the clear context; S7 decodes without correction to 'la caretera'; in verification controls 0 of 6,000 shuffled keys and 5 of 6,000 group shuffles score as well. Verdict 'weak' kept: the key is clearly not chance, but its one pre-registered test failed and the held-out runs are used up.

texts.label: Van Halen to the Division auxiliar del Norte, Igualada 6 May 1840
texts.summary: 1,503 [reales?] are to be at the paymaster's disposal at Tarragona between 10 and 12 May; as a sufficient force must come to Montblanc to guard the funds, Van Halen asks the brigadier to meet him there on the 11th, unless the march of the Barcelona convoy by Cervera brings them into contact on the road before. The forces of Llarch (Carlist bands, by the contributor's notes) have been given fifteen days' leave and Llarch and Marcó roam the Priorat; the letter ends 'on that confounded road', after clear words that are uncertain on the images.

reading_review.by: integration reader for the project, after the contributor's AI agents
reading_review.note: reading.md read as Spanish sentences against decryption.txt, the plain context (frozen/clair.txt) and translation.md: both cipher passages construe with the clear around them and the translation follows. Three marked holes in 30 words: {custodiar} and {dichosa} each need one number read otherwise, ve[n]ir one number supplied. No human has read the reading; not checked on the images (PARES HTTP 429).

outcome.notes: New decipherment: no decipherment of the time and no edition known. The 24 attested values of key.tsv (CC BY 4.0) are the recovered key; its 40 structural rows are conjecture. The key was proposed by a language model in one API run by the contributor, who names it in NOTES.md; the addendum, held-out measurement, reading of S7-S8 and first notes are the contributor's. The pre-registered test failed; class and wording corrected at integration (12 Nov 2026). No image is included.
